title: Full-data inventory and cost/runtime estimator
objective: Inventory available artifacts, validate which datasets can support paper-like evaluation, and refine estimator inputs.
expected_outputs: artifact inventory; refined feasibility ledger; LastFM decision record
stop_condition: Stop if valid artifacts for a dataset are missing.

title: 1000-user paper-like candidate pool construction
objective: Build deterministic 1000-user candidate manifests with 20 candidates, 1 positive, and 19 negatives for valid datasets.
expected_outputs: candidate manifests; validation tables; blocker table
stop_condition: Stop if candidate construction cannot match paper-like assumptions.
notes: LastFM remains conditional unless valid artifacts exist.

title: Paper-like baseline completion
objective: Align BM25, MostPop, BPRMF, GRU4Rec, SASRec, and LightGCN settings as closely as feasible.
expected_outputs: baseline setting comparison; optional metric updates; training summaries
stop_condition: Stop before heavy training unless explicitly approved.
notes: May require training; keep Plan C fixed.

title: Paper prompt strategy alignment
objective: Map OpenP5-like, LLMRank-like, and LLMSRec/ICL prompts to project templates and identify deltas.
expected_outputs: prompt registry; alignment matrix; exactness notes
stop_condition: Stop if prompt text or examples cannot be reconstructed safely.

title: Full local LLM scale-up
objective: Run local Qwen2/Mistral scale-up only after E2/E4 and explicit approval.
expected_outputs: local LLM metrics; raw outputs under ignored results/raw_outputs; reliability tables
stop_condition: Stop if runtime, validity, or hardware limits are unacceptable.
notes: Not part of E0; no Ollama calls without approval.

title: Closed-source/API model availability and cost audit
objective: Verify current official availability and pricing for API-dependent models.
expected_outputs: official price/availability audit; budget scenarios; approval checklist
stop_condition: Stop if availability, policy, or budget blocks exact/near reproduction.
notes: E0 placeholder costs are not official price claims.

title: Mini API reproduction, only if approved
objective: Run a bounded API diagnostic only with explicit approval, keys, budget, and price verification.
expected_outputs: mini API outputs; cost log; metrics; limitation notes
stop_condition: Stop immediately if approval or budget is absent.

title: Llama3 70B cloud/API feasibility
objective: Assess whether Llama3-70B can be evaluated through cloud GPU or hosted API.
stop_condition: Stop if cloud/API path is not approved.

title: Generation-involved performance
objective: Implement profile-generation experiments only after prompt alignment and inference approval.
stop_condition: Stop if profile prompts or outputs cannot be validated.
notes: No generation-involved experiment is run in E0.

title: Beyond-utility completion
objective: Complete hallucination, position bias, history length, novelty, popularity, fairness, and candidate validity reporting where valid.
expected_outputs: beyond-utility summary tables; plots from CSV; claim-safety notes
stop_condition: Stop if definitions or required attributes are invalid.
notes: Candidate validity remains a project extension.
